what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Kenya in South Africa: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 367 Kenyan asylum seekers in South Africa, 4.7% of all asylum seekers from Kenya.
Refugees from Kenya, a separate group, live mostly in Ethiopia, Canada, the United States and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Northeastern Province and Coast territory in Kenya with Al-Shabaab in every year from 2015 to 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2002 to 2005, come before that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 304 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 10357, at the end of 2005, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in South Africa.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for South Africa only.
